component.name: word-sys PDF Editor
component.summary: Edit text content in PDF files

description.p: An open-source tool for editing content in PDF files on Linux. Edit text and images directly on the page, merge and reorder pages, draw shapes and highlights, and export to PDF or plain text.

screenshot.caption: PDF editing canvas with continuous page scrolling, text editing, and vector shapes

description.p: Major feature release introducing continuous vertical scrolling with viewport culling, interactive AcroForm filling and form builder, PAdES digital signatures with PKCS#11 hardware security tokens, permanent cryptographic redaction with automated PII detection and deep document sanitization, multi-language streaming OCR with neural models and region recognition, sticky notes and threaded comments, precision distance and area measurement tools, PDF compression with target size solver, AES-256 document encryption and password vault, clone and patch tool, modernized Quick Start Guide with live search, and an updated 10-screenshot visual showcase.
Updated anyconvert conversion engine to 0.1.9, improved vector icon rendering and desktop shell window tracking, and separated amd64 and arm64 architecture packages.

Multi-Document Tabs, Visual Document Merging Workspace with drag-and-drop page ordering, native pure-Python anyconvert export (DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, TXT), 90-degree Page Rotation, dedicated app-managed Recent Files hub, 4-way text alignment, strikethrough formatting, 7 language translations, updated Quick Start Guide, and Flathub GNOME 50 modernization.

Customizable New Document creation dialog with 18 presets and unit conversion, redesigned interactive Quick Start Guide with keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet, decoupled focal pointer zoom with Cairo surface caching, transparent PNG alpha preservation, vector stroke scaling, Linux fontconfig engine, and modernized PyMuPDF integration.
Adds freehand pen and highlighter drawing tools, checkmark and cross vector stamping, special characters and emoji palette, single-key shortcuts, keyboard nudge movement, and direct handle resizing.
GTK file dialog version compatibility fix, export format resolution fix, and Pango markup escaping for recent files.
Adds hyperlink annotation support with link de-duplication, plus localization and bold-underline fixes.
